subject: Re: Mid-term GPU reprofile & commit top-up request
messages:
From: Elena Cortez <elena@tidalhealth.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@tidalhealth.ai
Date: 2026-12-07T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Sizing request: mid-year top-up & reprofile

Hi Priyom —

Quick note from our ops team: we saw a sustained 3x increase in inference jobs for the cardiac pipeline the last 6 weeks (attached export). Our average GPU utilization on the dedicated pool is bumping into the 92–95% range during peak windows, and that’s starting to surface throttling and higher p99 latency for live scoring.

We have an upcoming customer pilot (Q1) that needs predictable latency and a guarantee on throughput for the pilot window (Jan–Mar). We want to discuss two things:

- A short-term top-up of GPUs to cover the pilot (3-month burst)
- Reprofiling the committed pool so the long-term baseline better matches sustained usage (move from N A100 slots to a mix of H100-like capacity + some quantized variants)

Can Redwood run a sizing recommendation + cost comparison? Procurement is ready to review a short addendum if we can get numbers and a proposed start date this week.

Thanks —
Elena
VP of Engineering, Tidal Health
Attachments:
- tidal_usage_q3_export.csv (CSV)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Cortez <elena@tidalhealth.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-08T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sizing request: mid-year top-up & reprofile

Thanks for the data, Elena — this is exactly the kind of signal we look for. I took a quick pass on the CSV and flagged a few things: sustained peak windows are concentrated 09:00–14:00 PT and you have a high tail for sequence lengths on the cardiac pipeline.

What we propose as next steps:
1) Redwood will provide a two-path proposal by EOD tomorrow:
   - Option A (short-term top-up): +120 GPUs (H100-equivalent) for a 3-month burst with predictable scheduled start (we can enable immediate burst capacity earlier if needed).
   - Option B (baseline reprofile + light top-up): convert 40 committed A100-equivalent slots to higher-efficiency H100-equivalent instances + add 40 permanent GPUs to baseline and enable a 60-GPU burst pool for peak windows.
2) We’ll include cost delta, expected p95/p99 latency improvement estimates, and a rollback plan to the current profile.
3) Karthik will validate model-level memory and kv-cache implications, Marissa will propose a commercial addendum.

Can you confirm the desired pilot start date (earliest Jan 5 vs Jan 20) and whether procurement prefers an addendum or an amended order? If procurement wants a DocuSign addendum we can turn around a signed amendment within 48 hours once the option is selected.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Attachments: commit_proposal_v3.pdf (proposal, draft)

Internal — forwarding Elena's data. Key asks: sizing recommendation + commercial addendum. Quick notes from the CSV:
- 6-week sustained growth, baseline increased ~2.3x vs prior quarter
- Peak utilization 92–95% (sustained), cold start rate small but p99s increasing during peaks

Marissa: can you draft two commercial paths aligned with my note to Elena? We should include a one-time onboarding credit if they commit to baseline increase, and an explicit termination/fallback for the 3-month burst.
Karthik: need an ops-safe recommendation (exact GPU counts, mix, and expected tail latency improvement). If we recommend conversion, include any re-compilation/quantization work and estimated downtime.
Monica: flag any revenue recognition or billing quirks for a 3-month burst vs permanent capacity (we may need a PR addendum).

I'll hold off external reply until we have the options packet.

—Priyom

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-09T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: FW: Sizing request: mid-year top-up & reprofile

Notes and recommended sizing after quick infra review:

Summary (technical):
- Baseline reprofile path: convert 40 committed A100-equivalent slots -> 60 H100-equivalent (higher throughput per card for their LLMs) via model-aware quantization and kernel packing; expected steady-state throughput +45% for those models, p95 latency down ~25% in peak windows. Net effective baseline increase: ~1.6x on critical models.
- Short-term top-up path: provide +120 H100-equivalent GPUs in a burst pool for Jan–Mar. These should be scheduled and pre-warmed with prefix caching to avoid cold-start latencies.
- Hybrid: convert 40 slots now, add +40 permanent GPUs baseline, and make +60 GPUs burstable. This reduces one-time cost and gives immediate relief for peaks while improving long-term unit economics.

Operational considerations:
- Recompilation/quantization: estimated 24–36 hrs of model re-deploy windows per critical model (can be staged to avoid customer-visible downtime).
- KV cache behavior: need to warm prefix caches for first 48 hrs after switch; include automated cache warmers.
- Autoscaling policy: set aggressive burst threshold at 80% sustained usage to trigger pre-warming.

Numbers (illustrative):
- Option A (3-month burst): +120 GPUs, estimated incremental cost $235k/month (pass-through pricing in proposal).
- Option B (reprofile + small top-up): +40 permanent GPUs + convert 40 -> 60 H100-equiv, burst 60 GPUs, incremental baseline cost ~$95k/month plus amortized conversion cost in month 1.

I’ll prepare a short SLO delta note (latency p95/p99 before/after) and a minimal ops runbook for Marissa to include in commercial. Jonas — can you double-check rack-level capacity in the us-west region for a Jan 5 start? If we can promise start Jan 5 we should ask for signed addendum by Dec 16.

—Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Cortez <elena@tidalhealth.ai>

Priyom / team — thanks for the rapid turnaround. We reviewed Option B (hybrid) internally and that aligns best with our pilot risk profile. Procurement prefers an addendum (DocuSign) rather than a brand-new order.

We confirm:
- Preferred start date: Jan 10, 2027 (allow ops runway)
- Option selected: convert 40 slots + add 40 permanent GPUs + 60 GPU burst for Jan–Mar
- Procurement will review the DocuSign addendum; expected sign-off timeline is Dec 18.

Please include a clause for a one-off onboarding credit if the baseline commit increases by >= 20% for the next 12 months. Also include a brief rollback clause for the burst pool to stop by Mar 31 automatically unless renewed.

Elena
VP Engineering, Tidal Health
